candidates.name: Claude Finance pattern-harvest (adopt the 10 finance agents' workflows/rubrics, NOT 10 new agents)
candidates.improves_agent: Hartley Capital (Earnings reviewer + Model builder + Market researcher), WOLF (Statement-auditor-style live-state grader), Anvil/Hermes (Month-end closer, Statement auditor), Lens (Market-researcher synthesis loop)
candidates.what: Anthropic Claude Finance (May 5 2026): 10 predefined finance agents (Pitch builder, Meeting preparer, Earnings reviewer, Model builder, Market researcher, Statement auditor, KYC screener, Month-end closer + ops). Harvest the rubric/step structure into existing agents.
candidates.why: Vetted, named decompositions of workflows our agents already run by hand. Take the recipes, not the headcount (more agents != better). High Pragma resale value to finance/PE clients.
candidates.action: Registered as pattern source. Next adoptions: WOLF Statement-auditor grader, Hartley Earnings-reviewer loop. Installing the actual Claude Finance plugin/managed agents = separate NEEDS-APPROVAL step (cost + access).

candidates.name: Context-engineering / store-time memory discipline
candidates.improves_agent: self-improving-loop + all memory-using agents (WOLF, Lens, Prism, Pulse, Keystone)
candidates.what: Organize/compress memory once at storage time, not per-retrieval; combine vector+graph+temporal signals; context editing/sliding windows (100-turn eval: -84% tokens, no completion loss). Single agent ~4x chat tokens; multi-agent ~15x.
candidates.why: Quantifies and reinforces 'more agents != better'; extends Fable-5 memory-3x finding into a concrete storage discipline. The 15x figure is the strongest argument for a lean, shared-memory fleet.
candidates.action: Logged as today's lesson in agent-lessons.md (store-at-creation; shared-state over re-fetch; context-edit long loops).

candidates.name: Managed Agents vaults - env-var credential injection
candidates.improves_agent: fleet operations (fixes WOLF lesson #5: launchd jobs lose shell-inherited credentials silently)
candidates.what: Claude Managed Agents vaults now support environment-variable credentials, securely injecting secrets into the agent sandbox.
candidates.why: A first-class, audited secrets store removes the exact silent-credential-loss failure mode logged on the WOLF controls.
candidates.action: Standard logged: prefer vault/env-var injection over shell-inherited secrets for any scheduled agent. Migrating live WOLF secrets into a vault = NEEDS BOBBY AWARENESS before touching live creds.

candidates.why: Extends 2026-06-17-06 credit-starvation awareness + the 'watch for silence, every control needs a heartbeat' lesson. Learn before a connector degrades or the credit pool empties.

candidates.name: Self-hosted sandboxes (public beta)
candidates.improves_agent: fleet infra / Pragma client data-residency work
candidates.what: Tool execution runs on your own infra or a managed provider (Cloudflare/Daytona/Modal/Vercel); orchestration loop stays on Anthropic.
candidates.why: Cost + data-control upside, but an infrastructure + security change. Not auto-deployable.
candidates.action: Evaluate only if a client requires data residency or we hit sandbox cost limits.

candidates.name: MCP tunnels (research preview)
candidates.improves_agent: any agent needing a private/internal data source (e.g. Pragma client internal systems)
candidates.what: Reach MCP servers inside private networks without public exposure via an encrypted gateway.
candidates.why: Useful when an agent must reach a private/internal source; no current need.
candidates.action: Revisit when a private-network data source enters scope.
